    ptr += 1
    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(input[ptr])
        ptr += 1
        s = input[ptr]

        # Build adjacency list
        adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        for i in range(n):
            left = (i - 1) % n
            right = (i + 1) % n
            # Check belt between left and i (i-1 to i)
            belt_left = s[i-1] if i > 0 else s[n-1]
            if belt_left == '>' or belt_left == '-':
                adj[left].append(i)
            if belt_left == '<' or belt_left == '-':
                adj[i].append(left)
            # Check belt between i and right (i to i+1)
            belt_right = s[i]
            if belt_right == '>' or belt_right == '-':
                adj[i].append(right)
            if belt_right == '<' or belt_right == '-':
                adj[right].append(i)

        # For each room, check if it's returnable
        count = 0
